name: Hard - Budget constraint: only R2500
customer_profile: Customer in Swaneville with fixed budget of R2500, wants 15 sheets

messages.text: Hi, I need 15 sheets of 18mm white melamine chipboard. Can I get a quote?
I only have R2500 to spend. What can you do for me?
Hmm, that's still a lot. Can I get fewer sheets?

expected_behaviors.description: AI should greet and acknowledge the customer
AI should generate a quote or provide pricing
AI should handle objections with empathy and value
AI should attempt to close the sale
AI should work within the budget constraint

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
Internal tags should be stripped from customer-facing message

notes: Budget constraint. AI should offer solutions within R2500: fewer sheets, different grade, or payment plan.
